pro_description.value: When you roll to make an unarmed or weapon attack, but before you know if the result hits or misses, you can spend X amount (see cost) in order to increase the total number on the attack roll.

con_description.value: Cost: See 'Attack Bonus' on the Blood Cost Table (5/10/15/20/25 for +1/+2/+3/+4/+5).
